method.liveRegionBoundary: MutationObserver captures DOM text/role/aria-live/aria-atomic changes beside the operated choice. No screen reader was run and no heard announcement is claimed.
method.receiptBoundary: Every response and command in rendered/focused answers is simulated in the browser or authored story. There are no actual API receipts, authenticated writes, reload persistence proof, or estimates of live failure frequency.
instrumentationLimits: General 18-case capture used an overly narrow direct control selector, so direct control/status fields there are null. Images, commands and MutationObserver entries remain valid. Focused capture resolves the labelled Ark root to its native switch and measures the associated status.
Focused native input geometry is 1x1 because the input is visually hidden; this is not the visible switch size.

Preference keyboard-recovered images use programmatic focus followed by Enter and do not prove a full Tab traversal. Natural Tab recovery was independently measured for notification last-row conflict at both sizes.
toBeVisible in original stories does not establish that an element is completely within the viewport. Independent screenshot/geometry inspection found the last conflict clipping.
method.sharedDataPolicy: No new corpus, fixture import/reset/refresh, shared writes or shared account use. No full regression. Ports 42829 and 42830 started by these probes were stopped and observed closed.
